notes: One journey, Biku's script as written: from the gym to the giant brass balance and the two scientists; the 10 KG block of fat drops on the left pan and the beam tips; the 29 KG block of oxygen joins it (29 KG, OXYGEN IN); on the right, the 28 KG block of CO2 and the 11 KG block of water (28 + 11 KG, GAS AND WATER OUT) bring the beam level (39 = 39, NOTHING VANISHED); the sofa, panting puffs and dizzy stars; back in the bathroom the breath cloud with a dinner plate in it; the scale at 71.0 under YOU BREATHED / IT OUT. Measured: never empty, never still.
